March 12, 2018 - By Peter Kolinski 
Guardian Capital Advisors Lp increased its stake in Enbridge Inc (ENB) by 4.87% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guardian Capital Advisors Lp bought 10,565 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.78% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 227,502 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.28 million, up from 216,937 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guardian Capital Advisors Lp who had been investing in Enbridge Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $55.12B market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $32.08. About 92,587 shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 0.40% since March 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.10% the S&P500. 
Fenimore Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Mednax Inc. (MD) by 18.02% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fenimore Asset Management Inc sold 157,455 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.94% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 716,505 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $30.90 million, down from 873,960 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fenimore Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Mednax Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.15% or $0.085 during the last trading session, reaching $57.665. About 10,287 shares traded. MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) has declined 18.20% since March 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.90% the S&P500. 
Among 18 analysts covering MEDNAX ( NYSE:MD ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 28% are positive. MEDNAX had 50 analyst reports since July 31, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, February 8 by Piper Jaffray. The stock of MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Friday, July 28. The stock of MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, August 31 by Jefferies. The firm has “Hold” rating by Robert W. Baird given on Thursday, October 5. The stock of MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) earned “Buy” rating by Stephens on Thursday, February 8. As per Monday, September 18, the company rating was upgraded by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The rating was downgraded by Bank of America on Friday, May 5 to “Underperform”. The stock of MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) earned “Hold” rating by Robert W. Baird on Thursday, February 8. Robert W. Baird maintained it with “Neutral” rating and $48 target in Friday, November 3 report. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Mizuho given on Wednesday, November 9. 
Analysts await MEDNAX, Inc. (NYSE:MD) to report earnings on April, 19. They expect $0.81 earnings per share, up 15.71% or $0.11 from last year’s $0.7 per share. MD’s profit will be $75.14M for 17.80 P/E if the $0.81 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.82 actual earnings per share reported by MEDNAX, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -1.22% negative EPS growth. 
Fenimore Asset Management Inc, which manages about $2.04B and $2.49 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) by 8,863 shares to 26,584 shares, valued at $2.18 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Interpublic Group Of Companies (NYSE:IPG) by 19,505 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.58 million shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
